subject: Learning Methods
title: Context-Dependent Memory
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Context-Dependent Memory.

hook.text: Divers who learned words underwater recalled them better underwater than on land. Context is a memory cue.

buildup.text: Your brain encodes the environment alongside the information. The room, the smells, the background music.

discovery.text: Returning to the original context provides retrieval cues that unlock what you stored there.

twist.text: This explains why you forget why you walked into a room. The doorway erased the context cue.

climax.text: Study in varied environments to build multiple cues. Or study where you'll be tested.

punchline.text: Same place, easier recall. Varied places, stronger memory.

quiz.question: Why did divers recall words better underwater?
options: The matching context provided retrieval cues
